title: ccr.stats
description:
Get cross-cluster replication stats.

This API returns stats about auto-following and the same shard-level stats as the get follower stats API.

master_timeout.description:
The period to wait for a connection to the master node.
If the master node is not available before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.
It can also be set to `-1` to indicate that the request should never timeout.

timeout.description: The period to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.
